name: gbm_tabular
title: An XGBoost tabular baseline with no torch anywhere
origin: the GBM script the ROADMAP's ANA-12 entry asks the corpus to contain

expected.defect: the ordinal encoder is fitted on the whole frame seven lines before the split
expected.why: category codes are assigned from the held-out rows as well, so an unseen category is never unseen

expected.defect: the scaler is fitted on the whole frame before the split
expected.why: held-out means and variances are inside the training features

expected.defect: the same scaler is re-fitted on the held-out half and used to transform it
expected.why: the model is scored on features standardised by their own statistics, not by the training statistics it learned from
the AUC printed is not reproducible

expected.defect: XGBClassifier is constructed without random_state and nothing seeds numpy
expected.why: column subsampling and the split both move between runs

forbidden.why: roc_auc_score is given model.predict_proba(test_x)[:, 1], which is a score column, not a hard label
the only metric here is roc_auc_score, which is in the score-metric carve-out and legitimately takes continuous scores
there is no torch in this project and no hand-written gradient step to zero
model.eval() is a torch idiom with no xgboost equivalent
torch.no_grad() has no meaning in an xgboost program
no device is ever named in this project
no class is defined in this file at all
no submodule container is built here
there is no cross-validation in this script for the preprocessing to sit outside of
